technology_name: A COAGULATION REACTOR FOR DAIRY WASTEWATER TREATMENT AND METHOD OF OPERATING THE SAME WITH PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Dairy processing plants discard high volumes of nutrient-dense wastewater that overloads local aquatic systems while generating high volumes of unrecyclable sludge waste.
description: An integrated circular economy wastewater treatment plant design introducing a multi-stage coagulation reactor running completely organic, bio-derived natural coagulants to cleanly separate residual waste dairy solids into high-protein animal feeds.
applications: Industrial dairy wastewater treatment facilities, commercial farm waste recycling hubs, green fertilizer production plants, and circular agricultural operations.
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, MedTech & Health Care, Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
